section: 4. Adam, the Tree, and the Iblis Pact
caption: Shows the ranked succession from the Speaking Prophet through the Foundation-Imam down to the Proof in each prophetic cycle.

caption: Pairs the manifest Imam with the concealed Hujja through the recurring sign-pairs God set in creation.

anchor_text: They are seven: Adam, Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus
caption: Lists the seven Speaking Prophets in sequence, ending with the Qa'im of the Age.

caption: Contrasts the two parties named in Surah al-Mujadila by their defining traits.
